# Skinport preservation fixtures

`skinport-before-refactor.json` was generated from the original normalizer before moving it behind the transformer boundary. It freezes four cases using the existing `tests/fixtures.ts` source shape: complete observation, null prices/zero quantity and sales, absent History, and high-precision prices/unknown numeric metadata. Values are deterministic test data, not a live discovery feed.

Golden expected fields are never generated by the new transformer during tests. Comparisons cover all serialized persisted fields, including unchanged raw provenance and timestamps. A separate assertion covers undefined History fields omitted by JSON serialization.

There are no cs2.sh raw response fixtures because an authoritative endpoint contract was not supplied or checked in. Provider/venue distinction tests use explicitly constructed canonical test records; these are not presented as cs2.sh responses.
